_about.purpose: Structured-numeric and layout constructs that every CSI-formatted construction document contains. A detector span that is entirely one of these is a document-structure artifact, never an identifier — no real street address is shaped like a MasterFormat code, and no person is named '3 CIR'.
_about.matching: A candidate is suppressed only when the pattern consumes the ENTIRE trimmed span (fullmatch), never a substring.
_about.authority: Suppression applies to detector candidates (regex heuristics and NER) only. It NEVER overrides a denylist match — the denylist is the authoritative sensitive-term list, and a project number legitimately looks like 'CCR-21109'.
_about.scope: Project-independent. Safe to share across every project.

suppress_if_span_matches.name: csi_masterformat_code
suppress_if_span_matches.why: CSI MasterFormat division-section numbering, e.g. 32 13 13, 28 46 21.11. Read as a street address by the address regex and by GLiNER.

suppress_if_span_matches.name: csi_section_page_footer
suppress_if_span_matches.why: Compact section number plus page, e.g. '099000 - 23', in the running footer of every spec section.

suppress_if_span_matches.name: standards_designation
suppress_if_span_matches.why: Standards designations, e.g. ASTM A36, UL 1479, NFPA 13, ANSI/TIA 568. GLiNER labels the issuing body an organization.

suppress_if_span_matches.name: standards_body_acronym
suppress_if_span_matches.why: Bare standards-body or credential acronym with no designation following.

suppress_if_span_matches.name: dimension_callout
suppress_if_span_matches.why: Dimension and quantity callouts, e.g. '16 inches o.c. each way', '20 ft', '18GA'. Matched by the leading-number branch of the street-address regex.

suppress_if_span_matches.name: sheet_number
suppress_if_span_matches.why: Drawing sheet numbers, e.g. L2.0, E-1.1, M2.3.

suppress_if_span_matches.name: panel_circuit_reference
suppress_if_span_matches.why: Panel-schedule circuit and rating cells, e.g. '3 CIR', '40 CIR', '20 A'. The street-address regex reads CIR as Circle.

suppress_if_span_matches.name: date_numeric
suppress_if_span_matches.why: Issue dates and plot timestamps in title blocks and footers.

suppress_if_span_matches.name: cross_reference_index
suppress_if_span_matches.why: AIA A201 cross-reference index runs, e.g. '3.10.1, 3.10.2, 3.11, 3.12, 4.2'.

suppress_if_span_matches.name: drawing_scale
suppress_if_span_matches.why: Scale notations in drawing title blocks.

suppress_if_span_matches.name: signature_rule
suppress_if_span_matches.why: Blank signature rules and their captions on execution pages.

suppress_if_span_matches.name: form_placeholder
suppress_if_span_matches.why: AIA/EJCDC fill-in-the-blank placeholders, e.g. '<Insert name of Owner>.', '(Name, legal status and address)'.

suppress_if_span_matches.name: letter_spaced_label
suppress_if_span_matches.why: Title-block labels typeset with letter spacing, e.g. 'S H E E T  T I T L E', 'J O B  N U M B E R'.

suppress_if_span_matches.name: north_arrow_label
suppress_if_span_matches.why: North-arrow annotation read as a project number by the project/job regex.

manufacturer_context_triggers._why: Phrases whose presence within a short window of a candidate span marks it as a product or manufacturer reference. Near-zero false-positive rate in CSI Part 2 - Products. Used as EVIDENCE that down-weights a candidate, never as unconditional suppression — a real subcontractor can be named next to one of these.

csi_zone_markers._why: Anchors for the Division/Section/Part state machine. An organization named inside PART 2 - PRODUCTS of a technical division is overwhelmingly a manufacturer; one named inside Division 00 (Procurement and Contracting Requirements) is overwhelmingly a project party.
